gold_annotation.scope: Technical technologies, tools, methods, protocols, platforms, and explicitly required spoken-language proficiency. Excludes soft skills, education, age, years of experience, job titles, generic duties, and nontechnical employer context.
gold_annotation.matching: Unique skill concepts per job across requirements and responsibilities. Case, punctuation, obvious spelling variants, and direct aliases are normalized for evaluation.
gold_annotation.limitation: Gold annotations require human review; broad or ambiguous concepts may change counts.
